sentry.section.title: Sentry
sentry.section.desc: Read your Sentry issues here, and let IntelyFIX hand one to an agent. The app only reads, and assigns or resolves an issue when you click.
sentry.section.baseDesc: https://sentry.io, or the address of your own Sentry server.
sentry.section.orgDesc: The short name in your Sentry address.
sentry.section.hasToken: A token is saved in your Keychain.
sentry.section.tokenDropped: The address changed, so the saved token was removed: a token only works for the Sentry it was made in. Enter it again.
sentry.section.scopes: A personal token with the scopes org:read, project:read, event:read, event:write, member:read and team:read (the last two fill the assign menu).
sentry.section.notPerson: This token is not a person's: issues can be read, but not assigned to you.
intelyfix.name: IntelyFIX
intelyfix.fix.startedDesc: Working in {repos}. Read the change in the Changes tree and commit it yourself.
intelyfix.fix.running: A fix for {id} is already running
intelyfix.fix.noRepo: Which repository is {project}? Pick it in the New run dialog, or map the project in Settings > IntelyFIX.
intelyfix.unassigned: {id} is not assigned to anyone now
intelyfix.resolvedNext: {id} will be resolved with the next release
intelyfix.done.triage: {id}: IntelyFIX could not fix it safely
intelyfix.done.triageDesc: Read what the agent found, then decide what to do.
intelyfix.done.cause: Cause: {cause}. Read its changes, then mark the issue as resolved when the fix is in.
intelyfix.section.title: IntelyFIX
intelyfix.section.desc: One click on a Sentry issue assigns it, starts an agent on the right repository with the right prompt, and links the run to the issue. The agent edits files and never commits or pushes: you read the change and commit it.
intelyfix.set.howDesc: Which run a press of Fix starts, and who gets the issue.
intelyfix.set.start.review: Open the New run dialog, filled in
intelyfix.set.startDesc: When the app needs a decision (no repository could be told, the start is refused) the dialog opens anyway, with the reason.
intelyfix.set.assignee.me: Me, the owner of the token
intelyfix.set.assigneeDesc: Taking the issue tells your team that someone is on it. People and teams are read from Sentry when you open this list.
intelyfix.set.roleDesc: The role of the fix run. Developer edits files in the working tree and never commits.
intelyfix.set.reposDesc: Where the issues of a Sentry project are fixed. The first is where the work is; the others may change with it (the backend of a front end that shows the symptom). Without a choice IntelyFIX takes the only repository, or the one named like the project, and asks when it cannot tell.
intelyfix.set.noProjects: The Sentry projects show here once Sentry is connected.
intelyfix.set.promptDesc: What the agent is told. Leave it as it is, or write your own.
